title: BHOC Veterinary and AB-Vet Buneba Plan Next Stage | BHOC Vet
description: BHOC Veterinary and AB-Vet Buneba in Tbilisi outline the next stage of their three-year collaboration in veterinary research and education.
heading: BHOC Veterinary and AB-Vet Buneba Outline the Next Stage of Their Collaboration
lead: The teams in Tbilisi outlined plans for continued veterinary research and education on November 10, 2026, after three years of working together.
paragraphs: BHOC Veterinary began collaborating with David Nanobashvili, PhD, and the AB-Vet Buneba veterinary team in Georgia three years ago. Working with practicing veterinarians has helped shape our research questions about oxygen delivery in veterinary medicine.

On November 10, 2026, the teams outlined their next steps. The plans include continuing veterinary research in Precision Oxygen Therapeutics and developing the educational side of the collaboration with ABU Buneba Vet Academy.
Thank you to David Nanobashvili and to every veterinarian and staff member at AB-Vet Buneba for three years of collaboration and for the work you do every day to care for animals and save lives.
